When you interact with our application, we may collect non-personally identifiable information, such as your device model and the Android version you use. A detailed list of the information we access and collect is as follows:

1) Installed Applications Information: When use our app to hide/dual the applications installed on your device, we collect and upload this information to our server. We do not share your installed applications information with any third party. Such information is collected, uploaded, and used for the sole purpose of providing you a customized list of recommended apps that can be hide/dual and relevant compatibility notes.

2) Device information. This may include your device model, Android version, advertising identifier, and language information. When you use our app, we collect and upload your device information to our server and use it. Since we use Google and Facebook SDKs, such device information may be uploaded to their servers as well. Together with the log information, we use your device information to help us fix bugs, optimize the compatibility of our app with other device and applications.

3) Log information. This refers to the information about how you use our app, such as hide/dual application opening/closing/crashing, without any personally identifiable information. We do not share your log information with any third party. Log information helps us understand user demand trends, develop better new features and provide tailor-made applications.

4) Location information. This is the information regarding your location (when you use a location-enabled service), including the location of your device when you use this app(collected from the GPS, Wi-Fi, compass, accelerometer or other sensors in your mobile device) and the IP address of the device or internet service you use to access this app. Some of your dual-open social apps(such as: whatsapp, facebook, and so on) and map apps need to use location information. In order for you to better use these apps, we need these permissions. We do not share your location information with any third party.

For further details, kindly refer to our Privacy Policy.
